query:
UPDATE jobs
        SET status = CASE
                       WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN 'dead'
                       ELSE 'pending'
                     END,
            run_at = CASE
                       WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN run_at
                       ELSE $2
                     END,
            locked_until = NULL,
            locked_by = NULL,
            last_error = $3,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING status
